title: Enabling Efficient Batch Serving for LMaaS via Generation Length Prediction
technique: generation-length prediction, similar-length batching with adaptive batch size, HRRN scheduling

optimized_metrics.evidence: Magnus can achieve high request throughput by batching requests of similar generation lengths

headline_claim.text: Magnus improves request throughput by up to 234\% and reduces response time by up to 89.7\%

extractor_notes: Abstract-only extraction. Response time assumed = end-to-end request latency (not defined in abstract).
